title: pharus lappulaceus subsp. glaber
intro: Pharus lappulaceus subsp. glaber, commonly known as a type of grass, is a plant species that belongs to the family Poaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties. The plant's bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, have been found to possess therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The health benefits of Pharus lappulaceus subsp. glaber include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory function, and protect against oxidative stress.
